en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning remains in force until 11:30 p.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a few squally thunderstorms are still expected over the territory this evening after the Amber Rainstorm Warning was cancelled earlier.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory has kept the Thunderstorm Warning in force until 11:30 p.m. on Wednesday after extending it through the evening.
Although the Amber Rainstorm Warning issued at 6:45 p.m. was cancelled at about 8:40 p.m., the Observatory noted that areas of thundery showers continued to develop near the Pearl River Estuary.

Members of the public were advised to seek safe shelter if outdoors, stay away from water and high ground, and remain alert to the possibility of further heavy rain overnight and into Thursday morning.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至晚上11時30分
zh.dek: 天文台表示今晚仍有幾陣狂風雷暴，黃色暴雨警告早前已取消，惟珠江口一帶仍有雷雨區發展。
body: 天文台將雷暴警告有效時間延長至周三晚上11時30分，預料本港仍有幾陣狂風雷暴。
雖然傍晚6時45分發出的黃色暴雨警告已於約8時40分取消，天文台指珠江口一帶仍有雷雨區發展，市民須繼續留意最新天氣消息。
天文台提醒市民如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿站立於高地，並警覺河道氾濫可能帶來的危險。
